deadline.value: Apply by February 15 for Fall entry; applications go through the FIU Graduate School.

fee_waiver.value: The medical school states there are no application fee waivers for this PhD.
fee_waiver.quote: There are no application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: GRE scores were waived for the 2026 cycle; the page does not give the rule for Fall 2027.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are waived for the 2026 admissions cycle.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The medical school requires 80 on the internet-based TOEFL and 550 on the paper-based test.
toefl_min.quote: must take an English proficiency test and earn 550 paper-based, 80 internet-based on TOEFL, or 6.5 on IELTS

ielts_min.value: The medical school requires an IELTS overall score of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: must take an English proficiency test and earn 550 paper-based, 80 internet-based on TOEFL, or 6.5 on IELTS

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Admitted students receive a stipend for the 2026-27 year and tuition is paid by the Graduate School.
funding.quote: Students admitted into the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science program receive a $30,000 stipend

entry_route.value: A graduate degree or a bachelor's degree from an accredited US college is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a graduate degree or bachelor's degree from an accredited college in the United States

notes: Interview required for admission. Application fee is $30 and is processed by the FIU Graduate School. Medical school English rule overrides the university value.
